Library
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

Data import
```{r}
data <- read.csv2("analysis_of_other_data/scRNAseq_data_updated.csv", sep = ",")

rownames(data) = data[,1]

data <- data[,2:ncol(data)]

```

Transpose and add columns(patient, group, cell_id)
```{r}
t_data <- t(data) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(
    patient = sub("_.*", "", rownames(.)),
    group   = ifelse(grepl("_control_", rownames(.)), "Control", "Disease"),
    cell_id = sub(".*_(cell\\d+)$", "\\1", rownames(.))
  ) %>%
  relocate(cell_id, patient, group)

head(rownames(t_data)) 
matrix_t_data <- as.matrix(t_data)
```


```{r}
Group <- factor(t_data$group, levels = c("Control", "Disease")) # Define groups, we usually want HD first
```

QC

```{r}
# QC preparation

# Keep only gene expression columns
expression_data <- t_data %>%
  select(-cell_id, -patient, -group)

# Convert expression values to a numeric matrix
expression_matrix <- as.matrix(
  data.frame(lapply(expression_data, as.numeric))
)

# Check dimensions
dim(expression_matrix)

# Check that expression values are numeric and non-negative
summary(as.vector(expression_matrix))
any(is.na(expression_matrix))
any(expression_matrix < 0)
```

QC
```{r}
# Calculate QC metrics for each cell

qc_data <- data.frame(
  cell_id = t_data$cell_id,
  patient = t_data$patient,
  group = t_data$group,

  total_counts = rowSums(expression_matrix),

  detected_genes = rowSums(expression_matrix > 0),

  percent_zeros = rowMeans(expression_matrix == 0) * 100
)

# Preview QC results
head(qc_data)

# Summary statistics
summary(qc_data)
```

```{r}
# Distribution of detected genes
ggplot(qc_data, aes(x = group, y = detected_genes, fill = group)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA) +
  labs(
    title = "Number of detected genes per cell",
    x = "Group",
    y = "Number of detected genes"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```


```{r}
# Distribution of percentage of zeros
ggplot(qc_data, aes(x = group, y = percent_zeros, fill = group)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA) +
  labs(
    title = "Percentage of zero counts per cell",
    x = "Group",
    y = "Percentage of zeros (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
# Patient and group from the cell names, e.g. "P01_control_cell001"
parts = do.call(rbind, strsplit(colnames(data), "_"))
meta  = data.frame(cell = colnames(data), patient = parts[,1], group = parts[,2])

rownames(data)
colnames(data)

sum(rowSums(data) == 0) ## no rows/genes that are 0 everywhere (across all groups/subjects/cells)

## first check cell-level normalisation and outliers, etc
counts_per_cell = colSums(data)                           # Total counts per cell
lognorm = log1p(t(t(data) / counts_per_cell) * 10000)     # Counts per 10,000, then log

gene_mean = rowMeans(lognorm)
gene_var  = apply(lognorm, 1, var)
trend     = loess(gene_var ~ gene_mean)        # How variance normally follows the mean
excess    = gene_var - predict(trend)          # Variance above what's expected for that mean
hvg = names(sort(excess, decreasing = TRUE))[1:200]
head(hvg, 20)


# Sum the counts of all cells per patient -> 2000 genes x 30 patients
pb = sapply(split(seq_len(ncol(data)), meta$patient), function(i) rowSums(data[, i]))
pb_group = factor(meta$group[match(colnames(pb), meta$patient)], levels = c("control", "disease"))

library(edgeR)
dge = DGEList(pb, group = pb_group)
dge = calcNormFactors(dge)                      # TMM normalisation

keep = filterByExpr(dge, group = pb_group)
sum(keep)                                        # Number of genes kept
dge = dge[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
dge = calcNormFactors(dge)                       # Redo TMM after filtering

plotMDS(dge, col = ifelse(pb_group == "control", "blue", "red"), pch = 16)

logcpm = cpm(dge, log = TRUE)    # genes x 30 patients, log2 CPM
```

```{r}
# 3. Variance vs mean on normalized counts across the cells
gene_vars = apply(norm_counts, 1, var) 
gene_means = apply(norm_counts, 1, mean)
plot(gene_means,gene_vars,log="xy") 

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

# 4. Find HVG (the ones with large dispersion)
# We select for genes with a higher variation than the mean

Dispersion=gene_vars/gene_means
top2000names = names(sort(Dispersion, decreasing = TRUE))[1:2000]
points(gene_means[top2000names],gene_vars[top2000names],cex=0.5,col="red")
log_norm_counts_top2000=log_norm_counts[top2000names,] # Extract top 2000 genes
dim(log_norm_counts_top2000)

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

# 5. Scaling (standardize values of HVG)
scaled_data_top2000 = t(scale(t(log_norm_counts_top2000)))
scaled_data_top2000[1:4,1:2]

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
```

```{r}
# 6. PCA
pca_res = prcomp(t(scaled_data_top2000), center = F, scale. = F)

# Plot variance explained
var_explained = (pca_res$sdev)^2
var_explained_ratio = var_explained / sum(var_explained)
# Bar chart of first 100 components
barplot(var_explained_ratio[1:30],xlab = "PCs",
        ylab = "Proportion of Variance",
        col = "skyblue",names.arg = 1:30)

# Extract the 10 first components
pca_embed = pca_res$x[, 1:10]   # Because we need to use more than two, we choose the first 10 components (standard)

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

# 7. Clustering with K-means
# Identify 7 clusters based on the first 10 PCs
km = kmeans(pca_embed, centers = 7, nstart = 200)
cluster=factor(km$cluster)
cluster[1:3]
```

```{r}
library(umap)
set.seed(43)
umap_res <- umap(pca_embed, 
                 n_neighbors = 30, min_dist=0.3)
plot(umap_res$layout,pch=16,
     cex=0.3,col=cluster,main="UMAP")
```
